**Subtrack:** Data Science  
**Unit scope:** Perceptual principles, honest encodings, uncertainty visualisation, narrative and audience-aware communication.

- **[DS-T2-011](DS-T2-011-one-house-style/README.md): One House Style: An Accessible, Regression-Tested Chart Style System.** Build a research desk's chart style system: implement CVD simulation, colour difference and WCAG contrast; design a palette that beats tab10 under an independent audit; provide a theme and annotation API; and calibrate a visual-regression check from measured benign and meaningful changes.
- **[DS-T2-012](DS-T2-012-the-tariff-band-explorable/README.md): The Tariff Band Explorable: Explaining an Electricity Policy Trade-off to Households.** Build a sourced, tested model and a phone-friendly explorable explanation of the trade-off between electricity tariff bands, supply hours and backup-power costs, then evaluate it with 3-5 consenting participants against a static baseline and revise it.
